text:
alex: Heads-up — bakery publish to eu-west-1 failed during multi-arch push. Registry accepted individual manifests but returned a manifest-list mismatch when we tried to push the index. SBOMs for amd64 vs arm64 appear different (ordering + a transient buildID).
marie: Seen that too. @samir did the Buildkite job use the same base image digest for both arches?
samir: I ran the same pipeline but cache behavior diverged: amd64 hit local cache, arm64 did a clean build. I suspect non-deterministic metadata (timestamps, build IDs) leaking into the image/SBOM.
jon: +1 — we should enforce reproducible build flags. Kaniko/buildkit support SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH and deterministic mtimes.
alex: Also cosign verify is failing on the manifest-list because our push order/manifest canonicalization differs across runs. We need to produce a content-addressed manifest list and sign that consistently.
eng-sre: Short checklist: pin base image digests in Dockerfiles, set SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH, strip transient build metadata from SBOMs, and ensure manifest list ordering is deterministic when pushing multi-arch. Also consider tightening registry cache TTL during rollout.
samir: Quick local test patch worked: use buildctl with explicit platforms and SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH. Example snippet I used:
```
DOCKER_BUILDKIT=1 buildctl build \
  --frontend dockerfile.v0 \
  --local context=. \
  --local dockerfile=. \
  --opt platform=linux/amd64,linux/arm64 \
  --output type=image,name=registry.redwood/bakery:sha256-${COMMIT},push=true \
  --opt build-arg:SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=${SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH}
```
alex: Nice. For SBOMs we also need canonicalization: sort package lists, normalize version strings, and strip ephemeral buildIDs before serializing (SPDX canonical form) so cosign signatures match.
eng-sre: We have an sbom-generator job in CI; I'll add a normalizer step that produces a deterministic SBOM artifact (spdx.json canonicalized + sha256). Also will add manifest-list canonicalizer before cosign.
jon: Regarding CD: our Helm charts currently point at the promoted tag (e.g., bakery:latest). We should switch to promoting pinned digests in values.yaml so rollout is deterministic. The image promotion job should update the digest in the gitops repo.
marie: Small operational risk — pinned digests mean more frequent GitOps commits. Suggest adding an automated rollout job that watches health checks and auto-rolls back if canary fails.
samir: I'll open a PR with the following: Dockerfile digest pin, buildctl multi-platform flags, SBOM normalizer step, and Helm values change to accept image.digest. Will add a smoke test that: pulls the manifest list, verifies cosign signatures, and compares normalized SBOMs between arches.
alex: :thumbsup: include a step to cosign both per-arch images and the manifest list. Store signatures in KMS-backed key and record verification artifacts in the release metadata.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: queued bakery/repro-fix pr/478 buildkite job (job id bk-99213).
marie: Timeline?
samir: Aiming for PR + green CI by EOD tomorrow. Need a follow-up publish attempt to eu-west after CI passes.
eng-sre: I'll adjust registry cache TTL to 20m for the next publish and add a smoke check job that pulls the index and runs `cosign verify` + SBOM diff.
alex: Thanks — please @mention me on the PR and ping #incidents if the eu-west publish still fails.
